brief: Current owner brief received 30 October 2026 after Week 4 was downloaded, verified and accepted as row 306. Both pathways remain at Explore.

accepted_predecessor.status: User downloaded, verified 178 files and 363 checks, and accepted as row 306.

basis: New Week 5 lessons are authored from the current brief and verbatim scheme outcomes. The accepted predecessor supplies the portable edition, resource and presentation structure. Accepted earlier files are unchanged.
build_review: Pupils select their own real Weeks 2 to 4 work, use picture-and-word prompts for two specific stars and one achievable wish, then make one real revision. A dry print may have a new labelled version on fresh paper; preserve the original. A live response has real observed before-and-after notes.
grow_review: Pupils compare actual work with the Week 3 plan, use a structured self-review and make one chosen revision. The log records the real change, observed effect, support and next step. A change is not automatically claimed to be better.
private_peer_route: At most one peer comment across the two periods. Maker and peer both opt in; the maker chooses a part to show privately. Either may withdraw. No class display or compulsory performance. Staff feedback or self-review remains a complete core route; record the actual route and never fabricate a peer response or name a peer in the template.

assets.basis: Original owner-approved mark retained byte-identical to the accepted predecessor. Print footers use a thumbnail from the same image.

Original exact review pictograms drawn with words: eye and ear, numbered stars, pencil and change arrow. High contrast and words support access without colour coding. These are prompts, not artwork examples or pupil evidence.

progression: One clearly labelled optional next level task appears in each GROW lesson. Explore learning is complete without it. Extra reasons, feedback decisions and evaluation may support later progression but do not certify all next-level requirements.
queue: Week 6 follows separately from row 93 as the assessing week, after Downloaded. No later lesson is included.
